A '''kleptocracy''' was a method of [[Politics/Legends|rule]] which followed the practice of might-makes-right, favoring strength. The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sanyassa IV]] was run by such a government during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The history of the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]] indicated that, in the preceding period, the society of their homeworld was more advanced.<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The kleptocracy of Sanyassa IV was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', created for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="UAA" /> In the real world, a [[Wikipedia:Kleptocracy|kleptocracy]] is a government whose leaders seek personal power and wealth at the expense of the populace.<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/kleptocracy|text=Kleptocracy Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20220212184646}}</ref>
